UK Reality Star Katie Price Reveals Shocking New Look After Several Cosmetic Surgery Procedures

By Kristie Lau-Adams
September 8, 2026
TOP STORIES
  • Share on Facebook (Opens in new window) Facebook
  • Share on X (Opens in new window) X
Tap Here To Add Us Magazine As A Trusted Source
Add as a preferred source on Google
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 2:58
Instaread

U.K. reality star Katie Price is debuting her eyebrow-raising new look after undergoing a series of elective cosmetic surgeries.

Price, 48, stole the show while walking the National Television Awards red carpet in London on Tuesday, September 8, revealing her ultra bronzed face, dark eye makeup, dark lip liner and slick pulled back hair. She shared insight into her nearly unrecognizable look, including the procedures she had to enhance her features, via Instagram just hours prior.

“Because one of my boobs was slightly bigger than the other, they put a new implant in and while they were there I asked … ‘Put a bit more in both of them,’” Price, a British reality TV star and former glamor model who appeared in the U.K.’s Celebrity Big Brother and Celebrity MasterChef, told her fans.

“At the same time, where my face is hollow as you get older and lose weight [I] put filler in obviously while I’m asleep, and he does it under the muscle right under the bone,” she continued, pointing to her cheekbones. “I didn’t have anything put in [my cheeks], and I think the swelling has dropped, [but] I look like a hamster. Sore.”

Related: Influencer Katie Anderson Shows Off 2nd Facelift Results at 48: ‘So Glad’

Influencer Katie Anderson opened up about getting her second facelift and a neck lift. Anderson, 48, showed off her final results three months after going under the knife for another facelift. Anderson started off the Tuesday, February 17, Instagram reel with her before look while mouthing Tate McRae’s “Sports Car” lyrics, “I think you know […]

Price also told fans that she’d engaged a new makeup artist, rather than her usual “glam squad,” to provide a bold new look for the event.

“The person doing my makeup, oh my God, I am so honored, so lucky, the person is absolutely iconic and at the same time, so excited to do my makeup,” she said. “He’s got to cover all this up. So, yeah, watch the magic happen.”

As to why she chose to go with somebody new, Price revealed that creative differences regarding her ensemble led her to look elsewhere.

“Originally I had a glam squad but they passed on doing the NTAs because I wouldn’t wear the outfits they wanted me to. But the outfit I’ve chosen myself is still different, because I don’t like to follow what everyone else follows,” she explained. “In a way, they did me a favor by saying they were going to pass on my glam.”

Related: Kaitlyn Bristowe’s Most Candid Quotes About Her Cosmetic Journey

Kaitlyn Bristowe has never been one to shy away from sharing details about her cosmetic journey. Through the years, the former Bachelorette has pulled back the curtain on what these procedures look like and shared candid recovery updates with her followers. She has also been open about criticism she has received about her appearance. “Everyone’s […]

Moving onto the striking hair style she landed on, Price said, “I’ve taken all my extensions out because the look I want today is the wet look. I want to have my hair all scraped back as a wet look. This is going to be beyond art, [it’s iconic.”

Deal of the Day

Price recently opened up about the cosmetic and plastic surgery procedures she’s undertaken over the years. During an interview for The Price of Perfection, she told British TV presenter Olivia Attwood that the total number of procedures is hard to ascertain.

“Oh my god, that’s really hard. Maybe about 30 or 40? I must have done,” she said on the show, which aired in the U.K. in August.

Procedures she’s spoken publicly about in the past include multiple face lifts, breast enlargements, a lip lift and multiple butt lifts.
